runtime_inputs: common full-frame raster evidence if used by planning

timing.start: Before fresh geometry/camera JSON decoding and any run-specific ROI discovery, resident/index construction or candidate evaluation.
timing.stop: After ROI discovery, all registered-candidate coverage, selected-view state/bitset updates, final result encoding and output byte count.
included: per-run scene and projected index construction
shared_setup_separate: input file reads and frozen SHA verification
timing.rendering: All actual fixed-image generation is reported separately. Planning reuses original images and never renders while sorting candidates.
timing.samples: All 40 raw integer start/end/delta values are retained. No warm-up samples, retries, replacements, extra performance samples or timer-overhead subtraction.
timing.timing_resolution: Record get_clock_info metadata. A difference within two rounded clock-resolution units is unresolved. Other timing conclusions are descriptive observations with all pair differences and spread retained.
timing.primary_median_comparison: median(optimized full planning ns) <= median(reference full planning ns)

workload_gate.comparison: 1 - sum(optimized exact clip invocations)/sum(reference exact clip invocations)

correctness_controls.name: rename_and_object_order
correctness_controls.changes: Rename all objects independently of geometry and reverse their enumeration. Compare geometry-normalized ROI/visibility/planning outputs.

correctness_controls.name: vertex_and_triangle_enumeration
correctness_controls.changes: Permute each mesh vertex list with exact index remapping and permute triangle enumeration while preserving winding. Compare geometry-normalized outputs.

correctness_controls.name: off_center_positive_area_occlusion
correctness_controls.description: A front +Z rectangle has center and four corners visible while a small separate box blocks a strictly interior off-center region. Continuous complete visibility must be false. The input supplies full geometry and camera only.

execution_guard.source_or_input_change: Stop and retain all entered and not-run slots. No replacement.
execution_guard.ordinary_pure_algorithm_failure: Record the failed scheduled run and retain the fixed denominator. No successful subset can pass the gate.
